notes:
Read: experiments/README.md (whole table and lessons), 08-METHOD.md §9 (theses table, both philosophical theses), and for each listed folder its README (or HOLD.md / DESIGN.md opening for reform-events and critical-mass-located) through its verdict or result section. Also read where needed: selective-handoff/README.md, agentdojo correction-action/RESULTS.md (first 40 lines), CG3's PREDICTIONS-ROUND2/3/4 openings, FIDELITY.md's registered predictions and FIDELITY-RESULTS.md lines 1-80, CONTROLLED-ENGLISH-RESULTS.md (decision lines), the ZE analysis plan's decision rules, SC1's RESULTS.md and DESIGN §6, and a few lines of 07-SIGNIFICANCE on LA3. I did not read the FREEZE-N.md files of formations-that-read, the PREDICTIONS files beyond those named, VD1's results lines 31-54, margin-measured beyond its answer and ledger, CMT DESIGN beyond its first part, or any home section in 02-MAP. Dates come from the READMEs and from git log of the freeze and result commits. Every quote was checked verbatim with grep -F.

Not classed: guardian-anarchy/ (in the table but not linked; kept local only, not tracked, not read). EW1, T1B and T2O get no rows. EW1 appears only as a mention in break-warnings and 08 ("consistent"); it has no file of its own in the folder. T1B and T2O are not folders.

Choices a reviewer should check:
(1) UE31b is classed failed, not mixed. Its W verdict failed T2's former wording. H1 "T2 holds" is, by its README, "a tie by construction" and "not T2 passed". 08 says it "failed its former wording".
(2) UE32 is classed passed: the frozen verdict was "T2 better". The answer expected before the run was "not separated", and both states forecast worse than persistence in most stocks.
(3) SE1 is classed passed: all six frozen predictions R1-R6 passed, per its verdict table. The predicted result was the reduction, so a pass means the blind draw adds nothing.
(4) FC1 is classed partly-passed: F1 and F2 were supported (F1 undecided on the calibration coding), and F3 and F4 were not measured. ZE and SC1 had registered decision rules but no predicted direction, so both are no-prediction. ZE's quote is an AI reading (D63). Under the cross-family coder a residual for the classical code remains.
(5) TR1A is classed passed on its frozen expectation. The README says the frozen script miscounts P1, so the P1 part of its expectation check is vacuous, and the comparator class was contradicted on 20 of 20 seeds.
(6) TR2A is classed mixed: it was reported without a verdict, one frozen expectation (every training fits) failed once, and the next sentence says its others held.
(7) IN1 round 1 is classed mixed: H4 and the identity check passed, and the other rules failed. IN1 round 2's partly-passed comes from 08 ("one model of two"). The README says one model passed R1-R4 and the other passed only R2.
(8) LA2 is classed mixed: the verdicts passed and the bridge failed. Its run spanned 25-26 Oct, and the run field gives 26 Oct, the day it finished. LA3's run also finished on 26 Oct.
(9) The CG3 rounds 1-2 quotes come from the next round's PREDICTIONS file, because the README gives their outcomes only in tables. The folder totals 22 of 30 graded conditions passed: 8/9, 4/6, 5/7, 5/8.

Quotes taken from outside the folder's README, because the README has no single outcome sentence: IN1 r1, LA1 and LA2 from experiments/README.md; MQ6, EW4 and IN1 r2 from 08-METHOD.md.

Thesis left empty where 08 §9 does not tie the test to T1-T8: LA3, CMT (its DESIGN says T7's forbids belong to T7F, not to it), all TR and SCL rows, WL/FC1/ZE/SC1, and the October pilots and reanalyses.

The not-run TR rows rely on the README's statement that the tests calling a model have not run. TR8/TR-RR and TR4/TR5 are one row each, since each pair shares one freeze.

Ids without a board code: LCA, selective-handoff, agentdojo and the reanalysis folder names.
